observation: Current frozen normalization v1 replaces Unicode combining marks with spaces along with punctuation. Raw fields remain intact. Evaluate a mark-preserving normalization v2 on a separate checkpoint before replacing frozen pipelines.

ablation_outcome.description: Latin diacritic folding (NFD decompose + strip Mn category) tested end-to-end on the capped10 pipeline at frozen threshold 0.585.

ablation_rejection_reason: Confirmation gain (+0.00028 macro F0.5) is negligible and insufficient to justify replacing the frozen preprocessing path. The folded calibration threshold was not evaluated on confirmation, providing insufficient robust evidence. DIACRITIC_FOLDING_ENABLED remains False in src/normalize.py.
